result.summary: The page appears visually functional with no critical issues. There is a minor layout issue with a partially visible card at the bottom, and a potential content issue with the '-0%' discount badge which is confusing.

issues.description: The bottom card (pizza image) is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scrollable content area has sufficient padding at the bottom so that the last item is not obscured by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The discount badge on the bottom card displays '-0%', which is confusing and provides no value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge if there is no discount, or display a meaningful discount percentage.

issues.description: The horizontal scrollable category list ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) is cut off on the right side, indicating there are more categories, but there is no visual cue (like a fade or arrow) to suggest scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle visual cue, such as a fade-out effect or a chevron icon, on the right edge of the category list to indicate that more options are available.
